verdict.rationale: The only SDK-relevant evidence is Stripe's own llms.txt, which tells readers to check the npm registry for the latest version when installing Stripe packages. That implies official client libraries exist, but nothing names an SDK, its languages, or its Issuing coverage. The Issuing API reference, MCP server and CLI are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for an SDK story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages, evidence that the SDKs cover Issuing resources (cards, cardholders, authorizations), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
